newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer- world economic outlook generally good.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer- world economic outlook generally good.

text.p: German Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Saturday that the world economic outlook was generally good but that there were still structural problems against which traditional "macro" economic policies were useless.
He added that in Germany, liquidity in the economy was growing and that the Bundesbank was watching this.
